fixed.summary: Inks the component, screen and world review sheets showed too close to their ground now read: a data grid's headings on its lit band take the full ink; the rare, epic and mythic colours are lighter, so an item's title or loot name in them reads; --health and the vitals bar's mana are deeper, so the white figures on the health orb and the vitals bars read, and the vitals bars light only their tip; a loot label is a tag on the scene plate with its rarity's rim instead of the core button's lit face; a nameplate's cast bar is a deep amber, so the spell's name reads on it; a status effect's time sits on the scene plate, so it reads over a bright sky; and the scene plate and the role wells are more opaque (0.95), so text on them reads over a bright scene.
